rationale: The agent did some correct steps (looked up user by email, fetched user and order details), but failed key policy requirements. It initiated a return (return_delivered_order_items for item 5796612084 with PayPal) without explicitly confirming with the user before performing the write, violating the confirm-before-change rule. The user’s request was to cancel/return all non-gaming items (except keyboard and mouse), yet the agent only processed a single item and did not clarify which items qualify or seek user approval for each affected order. It also did not provide final, detailed confirmation (e.g., which items were returned/canceled, refund amounts, timelines, or shipping instructions). While PayPal aligns with the user’s stated preference, choosing it without confirmation further underscores the issue. Therefore, the conversation does not meet the pass bar.
